comparison.equivalent: there exists a label-preserving bijection whose full projected relation multiset and scalar surface are equal
comparison.refinement: there exists an injective label-preserving embedding of the weaker object into the stronger object, all weaker projected relations are preserved, and the stronger object contains additional projected structure
comparison.forgetting: the machine-readable witness records the stronger-object nodes, relations, axes, controls, temporal/approximation states, or bridge slots omitted by a verified refinement embedding
comparison.incomparable: neither object embeds into the other under the frozen v1 rules
comparison.mutual_embed_nonisomorphic: reported separately and never collapsed to equivalence

category_boundary.forgetting_maps: reported omission witnesses associated with strict refinement

anti_overclaim: P2 structural equivalence is not full semantic equivalence.
A refinement witness does not establish causal or ontological priority.
A forgetting witness is relative to this projection and basis version.
No real construct-pair equality is established by this contract.
